author: littlecengiz
quote:
The graphics are modern, but the game has no soul. The very thing its name stands for — auto theft — feels underwhelming.

The game's raison d'être was to let us do things we wouldn't normally do in real life: steal cars, mug people, beat people up. Taking out the trash and cleaning, on the other hand, are things we already do in everyday life.

It misses the point. It's turned into a massive avatar simulator.
